stories.title: Vessels seized by the U.S. this week were part of a global 'shadow fleet'
stories.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Elisabeth Braw, senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, about shadow vessels, after the U.S. military's seizure of two Iranian-linked oil tankers.

stories.title: War ripple effects to global south
stories.summary: The war in the Middle East is affecting countries all over the world - for instance, Egypt is turning off street lamps and closing business early. In Thailand, some schools have gone remote to save transportation fuel--and more. Fatma Tanis, correspondent. Marc Silver, editor. Radio (ATC Friday) and digital (TBD).

stories.title: Migrant workers in Dubai bear economic brunt of Iran war
stories.summary: Low-paid migrant workers in Dubai are being squeezed further by economic fallout from the U.S.-Israel war with Iran.

stories.title: Trump's week of battles and losses
stories.summary: President Trump campaigned on promises of victories on everything from the economy to foreign policy, but he has seen some major setbacks in recent weeks.

stories.title: A real-life Kraken stalked the seas of the late Cretaceous
stories.summary: Researchers discovered evidence of enormous Kraken-like creatures who hunted in the seas some 100 million years ago, competing with large apex predators.

stories.title: For Nikki Glaser, joking about thorny subjects is a practiced skill
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Nikki Glaser about her new comedy special on Hulu, Good Girl.
